reason: Live: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash via OpenRouter failed a whole turn with 'provider returned malformed tool arguments' (tool name '', 2-byte arguments, 'Unterminated string starting at char 0', finish tool_calls). The route streamed a complete call and then the tail of its arguments again under a new index with no id or name; _merge_tool_call_deltas keyed deltas by index, so the tail became a nameless second call, and every adapter (OpenAI-compatible stream and complete, Responses, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock) raised on any single unreadable call, losing the good calls beside it. Now stream assembly looks calls up by id before index (a new id or name on a known index starts a new call), identity-less fragments join the call before them when the result parses or are dropped with providers.tool_call.stray_fragment, object arguments replace, and an exactly repeated object reads as one. Arguments parse with strict=False, invalid escapes are retried once with lone backslashes doubled, truncated JSON is never completed, empty ids get call_<uuid4hex>, names decode case-insensitively against declared tools (leading functions. stripped), and a call that still cannot be read is returned with the new ToolCall.invalid_reason and empty arguments instead of raising. Chat's routing step answers it as a #487 refused, non-charging step counted by the deviation cap (output-limit responses keep the cut-off message), the specialist routing batch answers it with a failed observation, and the synthesis stream sees an attempted TOOL_CALL instead of a fatal ERROR. tests/v3/test_tool_call_assembly.py (audit shapes S1-S14 plus S7b streamed, the routing audit's W1-W4b through complete(), and each native adapter) and tests/v3/test_malformed_tool_call_feedback.py (real OpenAI-compatible adapter over a scripted wire through chat, plus the specialist) are new; 58 of their 63 tests fail on main 4c539df. The three synthesis-recovery cases failed on 932719d and pass on main through #493's rejected-call path, kept as guards that recovery survives the new invalid-call path; two adapter tests guard unchanged serialization and history-name decoding. The listed existing node ids are the tests edited for the new contract (they pinned the raise) and the tests that directly exercise the changed merge, name decoding, native call parsing, finish_response and truncation refusals.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/providers.py, chat.py and agent_tooling.py) never streams a malformed tool call; the Python tests drive the adapters and the chat routing loop directly over a scripted wire. The whole test_providers.py, test_openai_compatible_robustness.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_chat_routing_tolerance.py, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery.py, test_specialist_routing_tolerance.py, test_specialist_tool_batches.py, test_native_adapter_outcomes.py, test_native_adapter_requests.py, test_gemini_call_ids.py, test_provider_verification.py, test_provider_contracts.py, test_dsml.py, test_chat.py, test_chat_goals.py, test_chat_subagents.py, test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_context.py, test_orchestration.py, test_missions.py, test_chat_api.py, test_temporary_chat.py and test_native_hooks.py were run locally (647 passed), not in CI. No full suites.
